Offering both an HDMI input & output, the ADZ card provides an 18Gbps link direct to the matrix backplane. Supporting both 2160p 4:4:4 8-bit & HDR content and multi-channel audio formats up to Dolby Atmos TM , it offers the ability to use native HDMI connectivity without the need for a transmission port (reducing cost) and maintains an audio DSP output. It is the perfect partner for WyreStorm’s range of hybrid optical fiber HDMI cables.

Omitting the complex HDBaseT transmission port, this card allows an input, output and audio functionality to still be added to an H2XC matrix. Whether adding just another audio zone or tapping into the 18Gbps backplane for further I/O, this card can still do it all.

The latest 4K UHD content arriving via satellite, cable, disc or stream is all heavily encrypted. Being part of the growing H2 product family, all H2XC matrix cards and peripheral devices support the multi-point distribution of this content over HDMI, HDBaseT and multi-mode fibre.
